title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move getMetaDiagnostics out of protocol.ts into protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts (#25467 cut 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2dTVig4NQQadyC11Fs5BFZ)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 2 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cut 1 landed as #25494. The claim is `6370841668`, amended in `6371139599` to the narrowed scope below, which the seat agreed before the amendment. One `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` method body moves unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts`: `getMetaDiagnostics`, the sweep behind `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics` (216 lines at base, 26 of them from the last 30 days).

It is move-only, and the card stays open for the later cuts. Branch: `claude/project-thread-uasfag`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` at `5188e7f18f` after cut 1 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** At claim, none of the 12 open PRs touched `protocol.ts` (each PR's file list read; the Version Packages PR #24876 paged through all 395 files, which touch only `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json` in this package). Re-measured at 17:54Z, just before this PR was opened, on all 13 open PRs: none touches `protocol.ts`; `origin/main` (`fa06169c3c`) has not touched this package since the base, and `git merge-tree` with it is clean.

## Narrowed from the claim: `getDiscovery` stays

The claim named `getDiscovery`, `listLiveMetadataTypes`, `getMetaDiagnostics` and `SERVICE_CONFIG`. `getDiscovery` cannot move under the series' `.d.ts` bar, measured on a trial of the full claimed scope (not pushed):

- `getDiscovery` is public and its return type is inferred (`async getDiscovery() {`), so `dist/index.d.ts` prints the type the compiler infers for it.
- With the body moved in this series' shape, the stub's type is inferred from the new module, and the emitted `.d.ts` changed in two ways that are not union-member order. It dropped a property docblock (`@deprecated Use name. Removed in protocol 18 (#4828).`). It also spliced about 100 lines of an unrelated `protocol.ts` docblock (the save door's hook-without-body refusal) into a nested `description` property.
- Hashes: raw `fc33e319…` against base `8e1a224c…`; normalised different from base's `5b98a8e8…`, with a 111-line normalised diff. Under ruling `6348891160` that is a stop.
- On that trial the token proof and the package suite were clean; only the published surface moved.

`listLiveMetadataTypes`' body is barely longer than its stub would be, and `SERVICE_CONFIG` is read only by `getDiscovery`, so both stay with it.

**Carry-forward for later cuts.** A public member whose return type is inferred stays in `protocol.ts` in this series. Annotating its type would be a signature edit, and that needs a ruling. Measured on `5188e7f18f`, these 15 public members declare no type, so later cuts skip them:

`getDiscovery`, `getMetaTypes`, `getMetaItems`, `getMetaItemsForExecution`, `getMetaItem`, `getMetaItemForExecution`, `getUiView`, `findData`, `getData`, `validateData`, `createData`, `cloneData`, `updateData`, `deleteData`, `saveMetaItem`.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cut 1 applies it)

- The class keeps `getMetaDiagnostics` with its name, signature, docblock and position, because tsup emits members with their JSDoc into the `.d.ts`. Its body is now one host literal plus `getMetaDiagnostics.call(host, request)`, marked `[#25467 cut 2]`. The method drops `async` and returns the moved function's promise.
- `MetaDiagnosticsHost` types every member as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['m']`). The moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads (measured by AST), and the stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof getMetaDiagnostics>`. There is no cast, and no member becomes public or protected.
- The five members it reads go in as late-bound closures (`(...a) => this.m(...a)`), so a spy or double set on the instance is still the one the body reaches: `getMetaItems`, `shippingPackagesOf`, `artifactLockLayerAt`, `servedLockState`, `isArtifactBacked`. The body reads no field.

**Module-level declarations.**

- `type ShippingPackages` is also read by code that stays. It stays in `protocol.ts` and gains `export` in place, the only edit to it; the module imports it back as a type. `src/index.ts` exports from `./protocol.js` by name, so it is not published (measured below).
- The module imports `resolveItemLock` (`./item-lock.js`), `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` and `getMetadataTypeSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`), and `computeMetadataDiagnostics` and `type MetadataDiagnostics` (`./metadata-diagnostics.js`), from the same specifiers `protocol.ts` uses.
- `protocol.ts` keeps all its imports, since each still has readers there. It gains one statement: the import of the new module.

## The published `.d.ts`

Under the series bar (ruling `6348891160`), measured on base `5188e7f18f` and on the head. Both were built against the same dependency tree: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/metadata-protocol...` at base (13/13), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` at head.

- Raw sha256 of `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`: base `8e1a224c7d5a800c65c0174f9bc2245b70e0bab2106ab8dbf8a4b2dedd4ca35f` (both files), head `af5c30c9cb32b251f9a1b075e6347f372fe4be2561bee9c97731155b5d0a62a7` (both files).
- The raw diff is 2 lines, one swapped line: the services map's `status` union, `"available" | "degraded" | "registered" | "unavailable" | "stub"` at base and `"registered" | "available" | "degraded" | "unavailable" | "stub"` at head. That is a union-member order swap, the kind the ruling names.
- Normalised sha256, base and head (both files): `5b98a8e857554959f7561563d6a0742110c5d3d8ad6119065ed5a69b0bc06f95`. The normaliser, run from `packages/metadata-protocol`:

```sh
node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum
```

- Positive control on a copy of the head `dist/index.d.ts`: line 1348, `private engine;`, made public (`engine;`), gives raw `cbb86beef64be20057c3950401bc2d49d8cf9eefbcea52c02b59d47efa0e3baf` and normalised `f40390e5c426e0c6e24523cd6908726d3f3cab87f9a4ac36df20992bec04da95`. Both differ from the real hashes.
- Export tables: the ESM and CJS bundles each export the same 78 names at base and head, loaded at runtime (`import()` and `require` of the built bundles). The sorted list hashes `e47ac7c753bcb8bee1e79c1a5f79f7394cf030bd526de81ea8bcbfcb71fa024a` on all four, as at cut 1.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

- **Body, by AST token** (recursive `getChildren` leaves): the moved function's parameters (less the added `this`), return type and body have the same token sequence as the base method, and each body line is the base line with four leading spaces removed; `async` matches. 626 tokens compared, 0 differ. Negative control: one changed token makes the check report a difference.
- **Class side**: the class has 298 members at base and head. The 297 that did not move are byte-identical to base. The stub keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical, less `async`.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`**: 254 of the 255 base statements other than the class are byte-identical; the other is `ShippingPackages`, which gains `export`. The one new statement is the import of the new module.
- **Size**: +263 / -172 over 2 files. `protocol.ts` goes from 32,468 to 32,309 lines; `protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts` has 250.

## Readers of the moved lines

None needed editing; each was read:

- **ADR anchors.** No paragraph of the `protocol.ts` entry in `scripts/adr-anchors/` describes this body. The paragraphs cover ADR-0029 D9.8/D9.9 hydration seams, ADR-0119 `batchData`, ADR-0005/0087 view storage and ADR-0126 flow Regime C; `getMetaDiagnostics` calls `getMetaItems`, which stays. So no entry is added.
  - One decision letter in the body leaves the anchored surface: ADR-0110 D3, in the per-type `catch`.
  - `check:adr-anchors`: 82 → 82 anchored files; decision-letter citations on the anchored surface 1,979 → 1,978, measured at both ends.
- **Platform checklist.** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` anchors `protocol.ts#getMetaDiagnostics`. The method shell stays, so it still resolves; it is not edited, as cut 1 left `protocol.ts#batchData`. `check-platform-checklist` exits 0 at both ends with identical output.
- **Bracketed-refusal pin.** The moved text has no `new Error(`, so `protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts`'s `PRODUCERS` floor for `protocol.ts` (5) is unaffected.
- **Censuses and ledgers.** No `isSystem` read: `check-system-context-census` shows 149 sites at both ends, identical output. No engine `find`/`findOne`/`count`/`aggregate` call, so the `scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json` count for `protocol.ts` is unaffected. No engine write: `check-tenant-audit-census` shows 238 sites at both ends, identical output, no `--write`. No engine-double contract seam.
- **Source scans.** The package's source scans that read `./protocol.ts` (`register-item`, `lookup-artifact-item` and `view-expansion-reconcile` call-site pins, `hydrate-overlay-canonical-type`, `object-registry-write-through-spelling`, `query-transport-dialect`, `read-verb-canonical-fold`, the two recovery-door pins): none of their patterns occurs in the moved text, and all pass at head.
- **Behaviour pins.** The tests that call `getMetaDiagnostics` (`diagnostics-store-outage`, `lock-one-resolution`, `lock-door-read-agree`) pass at head.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` (package) exit 0; `eslint` on both source files exit 0.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite.**
  - Base: 21,476 tests (21,457 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 264 files.
  - Head: 21,476 (21,457 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 264 files.
  - Compared per test name and status: none lost, none added, none changed status.
- **Tests outside the package that read `protocol.ts` by path**, run at head, all pass:
  - `core` `row-serving-door-exposure.pin` and `second-object-read-exposure.pin` (7)
  - `objectql` `core-boundary.ratchet` (2)
  - `spec` `metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-absence` and `scripts/liveness/evidence` (44)
  - `client` and `rest` `discovery-double-retired-key` (3 + 2)
- **Hand gates at base and head**, all exit 0 at both: `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (2,384 anchors resolve at both, identical output), `check-adr-anchors`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-platform-checklist`.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --changed` derives 51 gates; all 51 exit 0 and `--ran` reconciles 51 of 51 with 0 NOT-MEASURED, each run at head with its exit code. The full list and the `--ran` reconcile are in the report on this PR.
